_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Recover the Past#000.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Recover the Past#000.dst: ……他还不知道。你得把消息告诉他。

Recover the Past#001.src: Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then-
Recover the Past#001.dst: 哼。也许只是力量不够……如果我能往法术里注入更多法力，那么——

Recover the Past#002.src: In the meantime, with our subject gone, we'll have to make do with another. There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#002.dst: 与此同时，既然我们的实验对象不在了，只能找另一个将就一下。今天有位侦察兵 Reynauld 在值班，他和你一样，原本也来自 Fruma。

Recover the Past#004.src: It's puzzling, to be sure... if only we could see further. I'll get to work immediately- we must know more!
Recover the Past#004.dst: 这确实令人费解……要是我们能看得更远就好了。我马上开始工作——我们必须了解更多！

Recover the Past#005.src: Use your Movement Keys to Preview your move, then press Jump to Confirm.
Recover the Past#005.dst: 使用移动键预览你的走法，然后按跳跃键确认。

Recover the Past#006.dst: 前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Picard 博士交谈。

Recover the Past#007.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#007.dst: 成功了！成功、成功、成——功！我是天才，世上最聪明的人！
Recover the Past#007.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#008.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#008.dst: 你，那边那个路人！你刚刚见证了一个魔法奇迹！我成功找回了好几年前的记忆！
Recover the Past#008.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#009.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#009.dst: 你看起来是从 Fruma 来的，对吧？那你跟我一样清楚，你对从前生活的记忆都消失了。噗。没了！
Recover the Past#009.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#010.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
Recover the Past#010.dst: 但有了这个装置……我们就能改变这一切！恢复失去的东西！找回——你懂我意思。
Recover the Past#010.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#011.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#011.dst: 现在，我非常需要实验对象……你倒是挺合适的，没错，但我得先更确定这东西真的有用。
Recover the Past#011.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#012.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#012.dst: 听好了！我有个提议。你想找回记忆，对吧？给我带来足够的实验对象，我就让你看看你失去了什么！
Recover the Past#012.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#013.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#013.dst: 我想想，我想想……我们需要原本来自 Fruma 的人。这附近就有几个。
Recover the Past#013.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#014.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p}- follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#014.dst: 你可以先从那个想当水手的 Caid 开始。他就在 {p} 过去一点，顺着小路一直走到河边就是。
Recover the Past#014.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#015.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the Past#015.dst: 这段时间我会在这里做些调整……它还不够完美。我还缺了一大块记忆……嗯？你怎么还在这？快去啊！
Recover the Past#015.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#016.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#016.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 他的船附近找回水手 Caid。

Recover the Past#017.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#017.dst: 怎么？我已经给你派了任务，你还待在这干嘛？去找水手 Caid。他就在 {p} 过去一点，顺着小路一直走到河边就是。
Recover the Past#017.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#018.src: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#018.dst: 嗯？噢！我呃，没什么好看的！只是……只是在看看我的老伙计船而已！
Recover the Past#018.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#019.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#019.dst: Picard 派你来的？就是那个窝在塔里的家伙？嗯。看来他总算完成他的研究了。可他找我干嘛？
Recover the Past#019.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#020.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
Recover the Past#020.dst: ……看我在 Fruma 的记忆，是吧？我不太确定欸。如果那些记忆不见了，那一定是有原因的。我、我在这里过得很开心！不需要知道什么……
Recover the Past#020.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#021.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#021.dst: ……好吧，行。我跟你去检查记忆。不过，先帮我个忙，好吗？
Recover the Past#021.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#022.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#022.dst: 我算是个工匠。想说试试自己造艘船，然后，就是它啦！挺不错吧？
Recover the Past#022.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#023.src: That's what I'm talkin' about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#023.dst: 这才对嘛，看到没 Reynauld！我就知道会有人喜欢！
Recover the Past#023.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#025.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#025.dst: 喂！嘿，好吧，你说得也没错。它大部分是用我到处捡来的破烂拼起来的。不过，以一堆废料来说挺厉害的，你不觉得吗？
Recover the Past#025.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#026.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#026.dst: 你得答应我别告诉 Reynauld……有些比较稀罕的零件是从卫兵营房那边来的。没什么大不了！只是从上头揩了点油……
Recover the Past#026.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#027.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived at the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#027.dst: 我只差最后一个零件就能完工了，然后呢，你看……铁匠那边刚到了一批货……你懂我的意思吧？
Recover the Past#027.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#028.src: Get me the part from the blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#028.dst: 帮我从铁匠那里弄来零件，我就跟你去 Picard 的塔。总不能让我的宝贝就这样没完工地丢在这吧？
Recover the Past#028.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#029.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#030.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#030.dst: 箱子拿到了吗？就在铁匠那里，从这里走到 {p} 没多远。千万别被发现！
Recover the Past#030.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#031.src: Bring the package to Caid at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#032.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#032.dst: ……你回来啦！怎么样？来，东西给我。
Recover the Past#032.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#033.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#033.dst: 铁匠什么都没看到吧？我有点担心 Reynauld 在盯我……
Recover the Past#033.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#034.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#034.dst: 啊，管他的！终于可以把我这艘老船完工了！
Recover the Past#034.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#035.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#035.dst: 好了！铛铛！看起来怎么样？
Recover the Past#035.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#036.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#036.dst: 没错！像样的船都得有个钟。没有钟就不对味了。
Recover the Past#036.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#037.src: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#037.dst: 你这是什么态度！像样的船都得有个钟，懂吗？你觉得 Seaskipper 会没挂钟就出航吗？我想也不会！
Recover the Past#037.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#038.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#038.dst: 总之……我想你已经履行了你那边的约定，所以我也只好履行我的了！
Recover the Past#038.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#039.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#039.dst: 带路去 Picard 的塔吧！来看看我这颗大脑袋里藏着什么。
Recover the Past#039.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#040.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#040.dst: 带 Caid 去 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的塔里找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#042.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#042.dst: 啊哈！你回来了！很好，很好，正好拿来测试我做的调整……
Recover the Past#042.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#043.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#043.dst: ……好吧。这就是我们要把记忆托付给他的博士？
Recover the Past#043.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#044.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#044.dst: 哎，哎，别小看我的天才。你不会有事的！大概吧。我估计有九成五，呃，九成的把握。好了，站上来。
Recover the Past#044.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#045.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#045.dst: 好吧……我相信你知道自己在做什么，博士……
Recover the Past#045.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#046.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#046.dst: 现在，我只需要……在这里启动法术，在那里拉下开关，然后……
Recover the Past#046.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#048.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#048.dst: 好，来看看这里有什么……Edwin，你能去查查那边另一个箱子吗？
Recover the Past#048.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#049.src: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#049.dst: 没问题。我说 Caid，你是怎么一直弄到这些东西的？这里面的零件很贵，看起来不是你买得起的。
Recover the Past#049.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#050.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#050.dst: 嗯……这么说吧，卫兵最新一批补给包裹，会比原本该有的轻那么一点。
Recover the Past#050.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#051.src: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
Recover the Past#051.dst: 等等，什么？Caid，拜托告诉我你没有偷卫兵的东西。你知道他们不会
Recover the Past#051.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#052.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#052.dst: Edwin，放轻松。我只是从他们的补给上头揩一点油。三十个包裹少一两个，他们不会发现的。
Recover the Past#052.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#053.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#053.dst: 再说了，我才不怕他们。他们是来保护我们的，不是吗？我猜他们顶多警告我一下就放过我，就像之前那么多次一样。
Recover the Past#053.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#054.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#054.dst: 如……如果你这么说的话。我想你说得对。他们其实用不着那么多补给。而且这些东西在我们手上能派上的用场比在他们手上大多了！
Recover the Past#054.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#055.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
Recover the Past#055.dst: 就是嘛！很高兴你也这么想。那么，你有找到什么好
Recover the Past#055.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#056.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#056.dst: 你们两个！站住别动，你们被捕了！
Recover the Past#056.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#058.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
Recover the Past#058.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#059.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#059.dst: 你给我闭嘴。你们两个，去把同伙找出来。
Recover the Past#059.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#062.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#062.dst: Caid，你因多次盗窃帝国财产而被捕。
Recover the Past#062.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#063.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#063.dst: 你的记录显示，你之前的行为已经收到过多次警告。这是你最后的机会，而你彻底浪费了它。
Recover the Past#063.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#064.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#064.dst: 把他带去监狱进一步审问，再决定怎么处置他。
Recover the Past#064.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#065.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#065.dst: 喂！有人吗？路人转职的助手！快从恍惚里醒过来，我们得谈谈。
Recover the Past#065.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#066.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
Recover the Past#066.dst: 嗯。嗯嗯嗯。记忆在那里断掉了……不知道如果我们能
Recover the Past#066.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#068.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
Recover the Past#068.dst: 是啊，看来是这样……不过，也许如果我能加大功率，那么……对了！我真是个天
Recover the Past#068.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#069.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#069.dst: 我就只是这样？！只是个小偷……我就只有这点用处吗？
Recover the Past#069.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#072.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#072.dst: 啊！路人转职的助——算了，我就叫你助手吧。看来你总算从恍惚里醒过来了。
Recover the Past#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#073.src: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
Recover the Past#073.dst: 不过那现在不重要！真正重要的是我们刚刚看到的东西！记忆栩栩如生地重现！这个装置真的会改变世界！
Recover the Past#073.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#074.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested- so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#074.dst: ……不过，我得说。我对事情的时间顺序有点摸不着头绪。Caid 被逮捕了，那他怎么会来到 Wynn，还当上了士兵？
Recover the Past#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#075.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#075.dst: 要查明真相，我们需要更多实验对象！今天有位斥候 Reynauld 在值勤，他原本也是从 Fruma 来的，跟你一样。
Recover the Past#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#076.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#076.dst: 对，嗯。你会在通往 {p} 的桥附近找到他。我就指望你说服他参加我们的实验了。以科学之名！
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#077.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#077.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 通往 {p} 的桥附近找到侦察兵 Reynauld。

Recover the Past#078.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#078.dst: 嗯……那道屏障在哪里？是这魔法不够强，突破不了吗？也许如果我加大功率，那么……
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#079.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#079.dst: 呃啊！助手！你在这里做什么？你跟斥候 Reynauld 谈过了吗？你会在通往 {p} 的桥附近找到他。
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#081.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#081.dst: 啊，你好。有什么事吗？你看起来像是有事找我。
Recover the Past#081.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#082.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
Recover the Past#082.dst: 嗯？那个古怪的博士想见我？要恢复我的记忆？我不能说我真的信任那个人……但我确实好奇这是不是真的有用。
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#083.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#083.dst: 不过很遗憾，我必须拒绝。我不能擅离岗位。万一腐化者突袭怎么办？{p} 就会毫无防备。
Recover the Past#083.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#084.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#084.dst: 嗯，好吧。如果只是一小会儿，也许可以。只要你答应，真的有攻击的话会出手帮忙。
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#085.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#085.dst: 那就这么定了。我跟你去见博士。不过，我们得先找个人来看守。你心里有人选吗？
Recover the Past#085.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#086.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do. I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#086.dst: Caid？那个……骗子。他一直在偷补给，我知道。只是我拿不出证据。不过，如果你觉得他可以，我相信不会有问题的。
Recover the Past#086.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#087.src: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#087.dst: 我不久前看到他往神殿去了。也许他改过自新了。你带路去找 Caid，我紧跟在你后面。
Recover the Past#087.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#089.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#089.dst: 也许 Caid 改过自新了。你带路去找他，我紧跟在你后面。
Recover the Past#089.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#090.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#090.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 说服 Caid 看守桥梁。

Recover the Past#091.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#091.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#092.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#092.dst: 是我们，我们想请你帮个忙。我们这位共同的朋友想拉我去参加某种实验。
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#093.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#093.dst: 只是，我去参加的话 {p} 就没人防守了。所以我们想问问，在我忙别的事的时候，你愿不愿意帮忙看守。
Recover the Past#093.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#094.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#094.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#095.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
Recover the Past#095.dst: 别误会，我可不想把 {p} 的安危交到一个小……一个像你这样的人手上。说得客气点，你不是我的第一人选，也不是第二、第三
Recover the Past#095.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#098.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#098.dst: 你愿意？嗯，比我预想的还容易。记住，如果看到任何即将遭到攻击的迹象，就跑去博士的塔，马上通知我们。打仗的事交给行家。
Recover the Past#098.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#099.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#099.dst: 我做梦都不敢想别的！不过 Reynauld，你想想看，也许过去之所以被遗忘，是有原因的。
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#100.src: Well, I suppose that settles that. Let's hurry to the doctor. I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#100.dst: 好，就这么定了。我们赶快去博士那里吧，我不想让 {p} 的安危在那家伙滑溜溜的手指里多待一秒。
Recover the Past#100.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#101.src: Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#101.dst: 谢谢你们的帮助，Tasim 和 {u}。还有 Caid……

Recover the Past#102.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#102.dst: 带 Reynauld 去 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的塔里找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#103.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#103.dst: 我们赶快去博士那里吧，我不想让 {p} 的安危在那家伙滑溜溜的手指里多待一秒。
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#105.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#105.dst: 啊，助手！欢迎回来，看来你把下一个实验对象带来了！太好了！
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#107.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#107.dst: 好了，好了，往前站。别害羞！站到这边来就对了！直直盯着宝珠，专心回想。
Recover the Past#107.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#109.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#109.dst: 对，对！别担心，这个装置已经在 Caid 身上彻底测试过了。很快的，我只需要启动这个……在这里施个法……然后……
Recover the Past#109.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#111.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour
Recover the Past#111.dst: 嗯、嗯？喂，谁在那里？这么晚了敲什么门
Recover the Past#111.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#113.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#113.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#114.src: N-no, of course not- Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#114.dst: 不、不，当然不介意呃。要是你，你懂的，先告诉我你要来就好了！
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#115.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#115.dst: 你知道规矩不是这样的。好了，货在哪？
Recover the Past#115.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#116.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never, oh, how was your week? Always just...
Recover the Past#116.dst: 好吧……你总是直奔正题。从来不会问一句，噢，你这周过得怎么样？总是只会……
Recover the Past#116.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#117.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#117.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#118.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#118.dst: 我从……呃，附近其中一间工厂弄了些零件。希望这……应该是你要的。
Recover the Past#118.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#119.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#119.dst: ……嗯。你说，其中一间工厂？你确定你干的时候没被人看到？要是我被抓到跟一个出了名的罪犯说话，你知道我们俩会有什么下场。
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#120.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#120.dst: 没、没有。我没被看到。我，呃……有做好防范。晚上去的。你懂的。
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#122.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you've asked for.
Recover the Past#122.dst: 那、那么……这样够了吗？你要的东西我都弄来了。
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#123.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#123.dst: 嗯……是够了，没错。但是 Caid，你知道我每次来这里跟你说话要冒多大的风险。要保你平安，光给最低限度可不够。
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#124.src: I hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#124.dst: 我哼。好吧，好吧，行，我、我再加点绿宝石。算是添点甜头。
Recover the Past#124.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#125.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#125.dst: 很好。一如往常，合作愉快。我过几个星期再来。
Recover the Past#125.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#127.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#127.dst: 啊，Reynauld。见到你真好。进来，进来。
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#128.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#128.dst: 请问这次会面是为了什么事，长官？
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#129.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#129.dst: 噢，没什么特别的。只是想跟你简单聊聊你的表现。
Recover the Past#129.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#130.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#130.dst: 你明白，我们这些在如此受人敬重的职位上为女王陛下效力的人，必须遵守某种……严格的荣誉准则，对吧？
Recover the Past#130.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#131.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#131.dst: 否则，我们怎么能确定我们的队伍里没有任何不法之徒？我们必须为我们伟大行省的人民树立榜样。
Recover the Past#131.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#132.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to... bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#132.dst: 那么，你觉得如果我们自己人碰巧……违背，或是打破了那份荣誉准则，会发生什么事？那又会开下什么样的先例？
Recover the Past#132.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#134.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#134.dst: 我很遗憾地通知你，Reynauld，你将被褫夺军衔，并以败坏荣誉、密谋反叛女王陛下的罪名被捕。
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#135.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your own secrets.
Recover the Past#135.dst: 你的同伙，那个供货的，前几天被抓了。我听说他没怎么挣扎就决定把你的秘密全抖了出来。
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#136.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#136.dst: 我们的队伍里没有你的位置了，Reynauld。可惜事情非得走到这一步。
Recover the Past#136.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#137.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#137.dst: 助手！快醒醒！还有别的事要谈。
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#139.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#139.dst: 太妙了！助手，你到目前为止干得非常好！我们离揭开 Fruma 之谜前所未有地近了！
Recover the Past#139.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#141.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#141.dst: {u}！？没想到会在这么远的地方碰到你！
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#142.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#142.dst: 寒暄晚点再说。Tasim？你怎么在这？Caid 呢？
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#143.src: The Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defenses. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#143.dst: 上将派我来加强 {p} 的防御。我本来以为会在桥上碰到你，结果只找到 Caid。
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#144.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#144.dst: 他说有一波攻势正在 {p} 集结，而你在这里，然后他就跑掉了。
Recover the Past#144.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#145.src: That damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#145.dst: 那个该死的小偷！我就知道不该离开的……这全都是个错误……该死。
Recover the Past#145.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#146.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go, Tasim and {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#146.dst: 现在没时间浪费了。走吧，Tasim 和 {u}。我们得去救 {p}。
Recover the Past#146.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#147.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#147.dst: 那个 Tasim，他应该也是从 Fruma 来的吧？如果他是你的同伴，你该把他也拉进我们这个小实验。当然是为了科学！好了，好了，快去吧。{p} 等着人去救呢！
Recover the Past#147.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#148.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#149.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#149.dst: 助手！你怎么还在这里？你的朋友们看起来需要你帮忙！
Recover the Past#149.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#150.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#150.dst: 再说，这也许是个把那个 Tasim 拉进我们实验的好机会！嗯，对，他肯定会是个很有意思的研究样本！
Recover the Past#150.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#151.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#151.dst: 他们随时都会冲着这座桥来。我们得做好准备。
Recover the Past#151.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#153.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#153.dst: 回答得好，士兵。不管他们派多少过来，我们都会把他们打倒！
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#154.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#154.dst: 先把你该做的事做完，但动作要快。敌人随时可能到来。
Recover the Past#154.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#155.dst: 保卫 {p}，抵御腐化者的入侵！

Recover the Past#156.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#156.dst: Tasim，你打前锋，我在后面掩护。
Recover the Past#156.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#157.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#157.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#158.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#158.dst: 应该快了……要是 Aledar 也在这里，就像回到从前一样了。你不觉得吗？
Recover the Past#158.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#159.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#159.dst: 我看到目标了！腐化军队来袭！
Recover the Past#159.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#161.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#161.dst: 该死。那个首领好像有护盾！我们要怎么打倒它？
Recover the Past#161.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#162.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#163.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#163.dst: 你说得对！Tasim、{u}。只要你们能让敌人别靠近我，我就能瞄准尖刺来一发好的。这是我们打倒这东西的唯一机会。
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#164.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#164.dst: ……啊。看来这可能比预想的难一点。不过，我们全力以赴吧！
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#165.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#165.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#166.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#166.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#167.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#167.dst: Reynauld！现在怎么办？这样下去我们打不赢它……
Recover the Past#167.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#168.src: I'm trying to think but... I've never...
Recover the Past#168.dst: 我在想办法但是……我从来没……
Recover the Past#168.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#169.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#169.dst: Tasim、{u}，你们继续挡住他们。我会想出办法的，什么办法都行……
Recover the Past#169.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#170.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
Recover the Past#170.dst: 我们现在不能放弃，{p} 还处在危险之中！
Recover the Past#170.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#171.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#171.dst: Reynauld，没有用！他们一直冲过来，我们……得想点……别的办法，不然撑不下去了！
Recover the Past#171.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#172.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. Three men alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#172.dst: 你说得对。我们得撤退，向 {p} 求援。光靠三个人打不赢这东西！
Recover the Past#172.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#173.dst: 但是，你们不是孤军奋战！
Recover the Past#173.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#175.src: Caid, what are you doing here!? It's too dangerous, leave this one to the professionals!
Recover the Past#175.dst: Caid，你在这里做什么！？太危险了，这个交给行家！
Recover the Past#175.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#176.src: I'm done, I'm done letting my future slip out of my fingers!
Recover the Past#176.dst: 我受够了，我受够了眼睁睁看着自己的未来从指缝里溜走！
Recover the Past#176.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#180.src: Now, Reynauld! Shoot! For goodness' sake, shoot! While it's distracted!
Recover the Past#180.dst: 就是现在，Reynauld！射击！看在老天的份上，快射！趁它分心的时候！
Recover the Past#180.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#181.src: It-It's coming down! Now's our chance!
Recover the Past#181.dst: 它、它要倒了！现在是我们的机会！
Recover the Past#181.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#182.src: We did it... We really did it!
Recover the Past#182.dst: 我们做到了……我们真的做到了！
Recover the Past#182.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#186.src: Caid! You made it! You're a hero!
Recover the Past#186.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#187.src: That's all well and good but, what about your boat?
Recover the Past#187.dst: 这些都很好，可是，你的船怎么办？
Recover the Past#187.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#188.src: I can always build another one, can't I?
Recover the Past#188.dst: 我随时都能再造一艘，不是吗？
Recover the Past#188.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#189.src: Ha. But not using my belongings this time.
Recover the Past#189.dst: 哈。但这次别再用我的东西了。
Recover the Past#189.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#190.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough, considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case. Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#190.dst: 嗯，考虑到这情况，Caid 看起来还算没事。保险起见，我带他去检查一下。谢谢你们帮忙，Tasim 和 {u}。还有 Caid……
Recover the Past#190.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#191.src: You must be wanting to take Tasim with you for your experiment. After all you've done today, I can hardly object. But, Tasim...
Recover the Past#191.dst: 你一定是想带 Tasim 去参加你的实验吧。经过今天你做的这一切，我也没什么好反对的。不过，Tasim……
Recover the Past#191.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#192.src: Think carefully before looking into that crystal. For some, the past is filled with things they'd rather forget.
Recover the Past#192.dst: 看向那颗水晶之前，好好想清楚。对有些人来说，过去满是他们宁愿忘记的事。
Recover the Past#192.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#193.src: Recovering memories from Fruma, huh... That's definitely something I'd be interested in. I've had a strange feeling about it, ever since we first realized we lost them.
Recover the Past#193.dst: 找回在 Fruma 的记忆，是吧……这我绝对有兴趣。自从我们第一次发现记忆不见了，我对这件事就一直有种奇怪的感觉。
Recover the Past#193.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#194.src: You were there, remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#194.dst: 你当时也在，记得吗？我们才刚进入 Wynn，然后……Aledar 也跟我们在一起，他第一天就差点死掉！希望他现在在外面有小心一点……
Recover the Past#194.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#195.src: Well, anyway. Please, lead the way to the doctor. I'm intrigued to see what it's all about.
Recover the Past#195.dst: 啊，总之。请带路去找博士吧。我很好奇这到底是怎么回事。
Recover the Past#195.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#196.src: Bring Tasim to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#196.dst: 带 Tasim 去 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的塔里找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#198.src: ... Oh, {u}, you're back with yet another subject I see! Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb.
Recover the Past#198.dst: ……噢，{u}，看来你又带了一个实验对象回来！太好了，太好了。请站到宝珠前面。
Recover the Past#198.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#199.src: So, doctor. You're certain this is safe? Reynauld warned me that
Recover the Past#199.dst: 那么，博士。你确定这是安全的？Reynauld 提醒过我说
Recover the Past#199.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#200.src: Oh, yes, yes. We've tested it with two subjects before, haven't we, {u}? Besides, I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#200.dst: 噢，是的，是的。我们之前已经用两个实验对象测试过了，对吧，{u}？再说，我已经算过了！全都没问题！
Recover the Past#200.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#201.src: There's only the tiniest bit of instability. Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then
Recover the Past#201.dst: 只有那么一丁点不稳定。哼。也许它只是需要更多功率……如果我能往法术里灌更多法力，那么
Recover the Past#201.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#202.src: Hold on. You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?
Recover the Past#202.dst: 等一下。它已经不稳定了，你还想往里面灌更多魔法？
Recover the Past#202.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#203.src: Don't you want to know what your life was like before? Even if it's not what you want to see, isn't it better to know?
Recover the Past#203.dst: 你难道不想知道自己以前过着什么样的生活吗？就算那不是你想看到的，知道总比不知道好吧？
Recover the Past#203.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#204.src: Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but I'll do it.
Recover the Past#204.dst: 好吧。我们可以看看我的记忆。我不见得认同……但我愿意做。
Recover the Past#204.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#205.src: Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
Recover the Past#205.dst: 太好了，很高兴听你这么说！那么。启动倒数三……二……一……开始！
Recover the Past#205.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#206.src: All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
Recover the Past#206.dst: 全员就位！逮捕那个叛乱分子！
Recover the Past#206.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#208.src: Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
Recover the Past#208.dst: 可恶……他跑不远的。你们所有人，搜遍全城！每个角落都别放过！别让他跑了！
Recover the Past#208.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#209.src: I- oh, this is bad... What can I...
Recover the Past#209.dst: 我——噢，这下糟了……我能怎么……
Recover the Past#209.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#210.src: ...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's...
Recover the Past#210.dst: ……该死。全都该死。我不能就这样让这个人流血而死，就算他是……
Recover the Past#210.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#212.src: It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
Recover the Past#212.dst: 没事的，你会没事的……我知道该怎么做，就算我真的不该这么做……
Recover the Past#212.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#213.src: G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get
Recover the Past#213.dst: 呃、呃啊！这、这是哪里？你是谁？我得赶快

Recover the Past#215.src: He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
Recover the Past#215.dst: 他在这里！而且还有同伙！两个都给我抓起来！
Recover the Past#215.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#216.src: My magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#216.dst: 我的魔法快撑不住了……但显然还有更多东西可看！加大功率……
Recover the Past#216.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#217.src: So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
Recover the Past#217.dst: 所以呢？我应该就这样让你在我家流血而死？别说傻话了。
Recover the Past#217.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#218.src: Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
Recover the Past#218.dst: 对！你就该那样！因为现在，我不但因为冒犯王室的罪名被捕，你还被揭穿是受诅咒者之一。要是你当时只是……袖手旁观，就不会这样了。
Recover the Past#218.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#219.src: ...It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#219.dst: ……那是正确的事。明明有我能帮上忙的地方，我不能就那样袖手旁观。
Recover the Past#219.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#220.src: Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
Recover the Past#220.dst: 是啊，这可真帮了我们大忙。你知道没人能活着离开这里，对吧？他们把你带走之后，就再也不会有你的消息了！所以，这就是我们现在的处境。
Recover the Past#220.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#222.src: Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Recover the Past#222.speaker: Royal Guard

Recover the Past#223.src: Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
Recover the Past#223.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#224.src: See you on the other side, Aledar.
Recover the Past#224.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#225.src: Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
Recover the Past#225.dst: 咳咳。我们准备好进行程序了。准备调整器。
Recover the Past#225.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#226.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to
Recover the Past#226.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#227.src: Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
Recover the Past#227.dst: 安静。开始之前，我要先说清楚一件事。Fruma 不需要你这种人。Fruma 也不想要你这种人。
Recover the Past#227.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#228.src: What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
Recover the Past#228.dst: 我们今天要对你做的事是一种仁慈，一种宽恕。如果照这个世界的意思，你的下场会惨得多。接下来的过程里记住这一点。
Recover the Past#228.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#230.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents would be useful.
Recover the Past#230.dst: 你是一名新兵，要被派往 Wynn 行省参加他们的战争。你之所以入伍，是因为你认为你那独特的……天赋会派上用场。
Recover the Past#230.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#231.src: Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Recover the Past#231.dst: Fruma 不过是你过往里的一粒尘埃。一个板上钉钉的事实，细节早已消失在假设般的过去里。你对它怀有好感，却什么也不记得。
Recover the Past#231.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#232.src: You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
Recover the Past#232.dst: 你会参加他们的战争。你会为它而活，你会为它而死。你将永远属于 Wynn，而 Fruma 会很高兴摆脱了你。
Recover the Past#232.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#235.src: Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
Recover the Past#235.dst: 要我再说一遍吗？你明白了吗？
Recover the Past#235.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#236.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
Recover the Past#236.dst: 我再问一次。你的指令，明白了吗？
Recover the Past#236.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#238.src: Wonderful. Take this one to the caravan. It looks like we'll be able to fit in two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#238.dst: 很好。把这个带去车队。看来今天这批还能再塞两个。
Recover the Past#238.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#243.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
Recover the Past#243.dst: 助手！快醒醒！你陷得太深了，记忆要把你吸进去了！
Recover the Past#243.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#244.src: Good grief- there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
Recover the Past#244.dst: 老天，你总算回来了！你知不知道刚才有多危险？！
Recover the Past#244.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#245.src: What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
Recover the Past#245.dst: 要是我的助手永远困在自己的记忆里，你觉得我会有什么下场！绝对不会是好事！
Recover the Past#245.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#246.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! Come on, come over here, we have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#246.dst: ……好吧，好吧。确实让我们得到了更多情报。但下不为例！来，过来这边，我们有很多事要谈。
Recover the Past#246.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#247.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#247.dst: ……哼。我承认，我……我不知道该拿这个情报怎么办。
Recover the Past#247.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#248.src: The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
Recover the Past#248.dst: 记忆复原化宝珠单次使用的效果已经好得不能再好了……但是，老天，那看得真让人难受。
Recover the Past#248.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#249.src: It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
Recover the Past#249.dst: 照理说 Caid 和 Reynauld 也经历过这些……而我的魔法突破不了那道墙……
Recover the Past#249.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#250.src: Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
Recover the Past#250.dst: 这就是他们在 Fruma 对待罪犯的方式吗？把他们赶出来，去打 Wynn 的战争？
Recover the Past#250.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#251.src: ... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
Recover the Past#251.dst: ……我得好好想想，我到底想在记忆里挖多深。不管怎样！这一切一开始的时候，我答应过你，可以看看你的记忆。
Recover the Past#251.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#252.src: The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
Recover the Past#252.dst: 如果你想的话，这个提议依然有效。只要站到宝珠前面，就跟其他人一样。
Recover the Past#252.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#253.src: Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
Recover the Past#253.dst: 怎么样？如果你想的话，这个提议依然有效。只要站到宝珠前面，就跟其他人一样。
Recover the Past#253.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#254.src: H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
Recover the Past#254.dst: 嗯、嗯？！宝珠！我美丽的记忆复原化宝珠！毁了！
Recover the Past#254.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#255.src: ... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
Recover the Past#255.dst: ……噢，算了。设计图我收在这附近某个地方。随时都能再做一个……但还是很可惜。
Recover the Past#255.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#257.src: Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
Recover the Past#257.dst: 噢！噢，对了！抱歉，我完全忘了问你怎么样了！你还好吗？
Recover the Past#257.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#258.src: None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
Recover the Past#258.dst: 其他实验对象都没有出现这么强烈的反应……奇怪。简直就像我们在读取不曾存在过的记忆。
Recover the Past#258.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#259.src: ... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
Recover the Past#259.dst: ……嗯。咳咳。总之，我得继续我的研究。一定还有更多东西可以挖掘……
Recover the Past#259.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#260.src: As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
Recover the Past#260.dst: 谢谢你的帮忙。来，这是报酬。啊，还有……我想你的朋友就在塔外面。你也许该去看看他。
Recover the Past#260.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#261.src: Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#261.dst: 在 Picard 博士的塔外 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Tasim。

Recover the Past#263.src: Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
Recover the Past#263.dst: 受诅咒者。他说我是受诅咒者。那对我来说意味着什么……？
Recover the Past#263.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#264.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#264.dst: 还有那个审问官……我不知道该怎么想。我们所有人来到 Wynn 时自以为知道的一切……全都不是真的。
Recover the Past#264.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#265.src: ... Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
Recover the Past#265.dst: ……我们两个真的只是纯粹碰巧遇见的吗？他在逃避什么，然后……一头栽进了我的人生。
Recover the Past#265.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#266.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#266.dst: 我、我需要一点空间想一想。去……反思一下。你能不能……请不要把这些事告诉 Aledar。
Recover the Past#266.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#267.src: He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's- he's better off not knowing.
Recover the Past#267.dst: 他不需要知道这一切。他他不知道会比较好。
Recover the Past#267.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#268.src: ... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
Recover the Past#268.dst: ……我想我会去 Gavel 行省。在海的对面，离……离这一切够远。
Recover the Past#268.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#269.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#269.dst: 等你变强了，你也该去那里。说不定我们最后还会碰到。
Recover the Past#269.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#270.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#270.dst: 那我想暂时就在这里道别了。不是永别，只是暂时。回头见，{u}。
Recover the Past#270.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#271.src: ... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
Recover the Past#271.dst: ……我只是在这里稍微歇一下。马上就会出发了。
Recover the Past#271.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#272.src: It's the box Caid was talking about...
Recover the Past#272.dst: 这就是 Caid 说的那个箱子……
